title: Correct the cache mechanism cards and the relaxed-freshness taxonomy
source_handoff: third review round, sections 3 and 4, plus the five card wordings the reviewer listed
acceptance_criteria: Pessimistic lock and conditional update are separate cards: the lock supplies serialisation and rejection needs the precondition rechecked under it; the combined 'at most one commits' guarantee is gone
The fill lease guarantee holds only while a valid lease is held, and says duplicate work can reappear if it expires or ownership is lost, keeping 'load coordination, not freshness'
TTL claims no bound on refill traffic: hard TTL bounds logical validity, early expiry spreads refresh work, and the matrix cell matches

The outbox is conditional, not a universal prerequisite: when coherence depends on asynchronous publication it makes the committed change durably observable, and strictness can also come from synchronous source validation or an authoritative read; the matrix gains a change-observation column
Bounded staleness is a named subtype of weaker-than-strict, not the definition of relaxed; the measured cells are described as unbounded-relaxed with no established maximum staleness
Each mechanism is described by one primary failure mode or control objective, not 'exactly one race', and no sentence claims only one mechanism is a performance control
Invalidation is scoped to lookups after it is applied, with in-flight reads and fills explicitly outside it
The fence card says 'in the measured strict writer protocol' rather than prescribing pre/post writer fences universally
The source-version card states its prerequisites: every relevant mutation advances the token atomically and the validation read is authoritative
Section 15.7's 'stayed correct only because' becomes an observation plus a mechanism explanation, not a causal claim without an ablation
The v2-16 write-path sentence is re-scoped to a labelled mechanism note that the claim does not quantify
expected_artifacts: revised cache chapter and card components
validation: no card states an unconditional guarantee the evidence does not support
